course_objectives.text: To apply the concepts of partial differentiation.
Demonstrate an understanding towards the applications of partial differentiation.
Examine methods for solving first-order first-degree ordinary differential equations.
Infer the applications of first-order differential equations.
Determine the solution of linear differential equations of second and higher order.
Solve first-order linear and nonlinear partial differential equations.

course_outcomes.text: Make use of properties of partial differentiation to solve the problems [L3].
Examine the applications of partial differentiation [L4].
Solve first-order and first-degree ordinary differential equations [L3].
Analyze real-world phenomenon governed by first-order ordinary differential equations [L4].
Apply concepts of solving linear differential equations of second and higher order governing different systems in engineering [L4].
Determine solutions of various partial differential equations by theoretical methods [L3].

course_abstract: The course focuses on developing important mathematical concepts in a comprehensible, coherent and rigorous way. This is achieved by means of a carefully balanced approach by including the topics of calculus and differential equations which will foster the analytical thinking, and problem solving abilities of the students. Students are encouraged to apply their mathematical knowledge to solve problems and clear their doubts through tutorial sessions. Students embarking on this course will be able to identify and solve various differential equation problems and will be intellectually equipped with the links between these concepts and their core engineering and real life problems. This course will enable them to tackle the problems of differential equations that they encounter in other engineering courses.

units.title: Applications Of Partial Differentiation
contents: Partial derivative of an implicit function using Jacobians
Maxima and Minima of functions of two variables

units.title: Ordinary Differential Equations Of First Order And First Degree
contents: Differential equations reducible to exact form - Integrating factors
Differential equations reducible to linear form
units.self_study: Differential equations reducible to linear form

units.title: Applications Of Ordinary Differential Equations Of First Order & First Degree
units.self_study: Newton’s law of cooling, Growth & Decay

units.title: Linear Differential Equation Of Second Order & Higher Order
contents: General solutions of linear differential equations with constant coefficients
Equations reducible to linear differential equations with constant coefficients: Cauchy and Legendre’s linear differential equations
units.self_study: Cauchy and Legendre’s linear differential equations

units.title: Partial Differential Equations
contents: Introduction and formation of a partial differential equation
Solution of a partial differential equation
Linear differential equations of the first order
Non-linear differential equations of the first order
